skills.name: paul-skills:ask-matt
skills.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill or workflow

skills.name: paul-skills:better-accessibility
skills.description: Reviews and fixes keyboard and focus behavior, ARIA, accessible names, forms, screen-reader announcements, motion and zoom in your project against WCAG 2.2.

interface.shortDescription: Focus, keyboard, ARIA, forms and screen readers

skills.name: paul-skills:better-colors
skills.description: Helps you build and check a color system for your project. It generates palettes, names semantic tokens, converts between formats and measures contrast.

interface.shortDescription: Building, naming and applying color systems

skills.name: paul-skills:better-interface
skills.description: Reviews screens and flows across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI polish. Routes change-review requests to an explicit interface-review invocation; consolidates its authorized handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-discipline interface review

skills.name: paul-skills:better-layout
skills.description: Helps with grouping, alignment, reading order, responsive structure and room for translated text, so a layout holds up when it is resized, translated or mirrored.

interface.shortDescription: Structure, grouping, alignment and adaptive layout

skills.name: paul-skills:better-typography
skills.description: Sets and reviews how text renders in your product, from the type scale and spacing to font features, wrapping, truncation and punctuation.

interface.shortDescription: Fonts, type scales, spacing and wrapping

skills.name: paul-skills:better-ui
skills.description: Polishes the surfaces, icons and motion in your project with exact values for border radius, optical alignment, shadows, icon states and animation.

interface.shortDescription: Design engineering details for polished interfaces

skills.name: paul-skills:better-writing
skills.description: Writes and reviews your interface copy, from labels and errors to empty states and confirmations, so it matches your product's voice and tells people what to do next.

interface.shortDescription: UX writing, interface copy and microcopy

skills.name: paul-skills:break
skills.description: Renders a component you choose under every scenario that can reach it on a temporary page and stress tests it.

interface.shortDescription: Render one component under hostile inputs and report what breaks

skills.name: paul-skills:build-design
skills.description: Builds an approved browser prototype, Markdown screen specification, Figma frame or design image with the project's existing tokens and components. Use when asked to implement a supplied design.

interface.shortDescription: Build UI from a browser, spec or design file

skills.name: paul-skills:code-review
skills.description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".

interface.shortDescription: Review a diff on standards and spec

skills.name: paul-skills:codebase-design
skills.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.

interface.shortDescription: Vocabulary for deep-module design

skills.name: paul-skills:design-browser
skills.description: Collect browser evidence for interface work. Use for reference browsing, rendered inspection, interaction QA, performance measurements or design comparison. Default to Playwright CLI; use Aside for research and general browsing.

interface.shortDescription: Route browser work and collect UI evidence

skills.name: paul-skills:diagnosing-bugs
skills.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose hard bugs and regressions

skills.name: paul-skills:domain-modeling
skills.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.

interface.shortDescription: Build and sharpen a domain model

skills.name: paul-skills:explain-interface
skills.description: Explains how a website, a visual effect or an animation was built, from a live URL or a screenshot.

interface.shortDescription: How was this built? From a URL or a screenshot

skills.name: paul-skills:grill-me
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.

interface.shortDescription: Sharpen a plan through interview

skills.name: paul-skills:grill-with-docs
skills.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

interface.shortDescription: Grill a design and write its docs

skills.name: paul-skills:grilling
skills.description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.

interface.shortDescription: Stress-test thinking a round of questions at a time

skills.name: paul-skills:handoff
skills.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

interface.shortDescription: Compact a conversation into a handoff

skills.name: paul-skills:implement
skills.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.

interface.shortDescription: Build work from a spec or tickets

skills.name: paul-skills:implement-spec
skills.description: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.

interface.shortDescription: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.

skills.name: paul-skills:improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

interface.shortDescription: Find and grill architecture improvements

skills.name: paul-skills:information-architecture
skills.description: Organize product content into destinations, labels and navigation. Use when mapping information architecture, a sitemap or findability from an agreed product brief, or restructuring an existing information hierarchy.

interface.shortDescription: Map content, destinations and navigation
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $information-architecture for the scoped product design task and preserve existing decisions.

skills.name: paul-skills:interface-review
skills.description: Reviews a branch, pull request or uncommitted change for the interface problems it introduced or regressed, across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI.

interface.shortDescription: Branch, PR and working-tree interface review

skills.name: paul-skills:pr
skills.description: Use when writing a PR body.

interface.shortDescription: Write a PR body that's fast to review

skills.name: paul-skills:prototype
skills.description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.

interface.shortDescription: Prototype to answer a design question

skills.name: paul-skills:research
skills.description: Investigate a question against primary sources and save cited Markdown findings. Use for local source investigation, docs or API facts, or web research through the Aside CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Research primary sources, using Aside for the web

skills.name: paul-skills:retro
skills.description: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.

interface.shortDescription: Conduct a retrospective on a coding session.

skills.name: paul-skills:setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.

interface.shortDescription: Configure a repo for the skills

skills.name: paul-skills:state-machine
skills.description: Renders every state of a component you choose on a throwaway page, with mock data and a switcher, so you can work on each state.

interface.shortDescription: Every state of one component on a throwaway page, behind a switcher

skills.name: paul-skills:tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

interface.shortDescription: Test-driven red-green-refactor

skills.name: paul-skills:teach
skills.description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Learn a concept in a guided workspace

skills.name: paul-skills:to-questionnaire
skills.description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

interface.shortDescription: Front-load questions into a doc for someone to answer

skills.name: paul-skills:to-spec
skills.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a conversation into a spec

skills.name: paul-skills:to-tickets
skills.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

interface.shortDescription: Split a plan into tracer-bullet tickets

skills.name: paul-skills:triage
skills.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Move issues through triage roles

skills.name: paul-skills:user-flow
skills.description: Specify a product task's actions, transitions and recovery paths before implementation, including unanswered requests, interruption, exit and return. Use this skill directly for flow planning; do not load state-machine unless the user explicitly invokes that separate component workbench.

interface.shortDescription: Map task actions, branches and recovery
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $user-flow for the scoped product design task and preserve existing decisions.

skills.name: paul-skills:variant
skills.description: Builds multiple variants of a component you're working on and helps you iterate and pick one.

interface.shortDescription: Several versions of one UI piece behind a picker

skills.name: paul-skills:wait-what
skills.description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.

interface.shortDescription: Re-pitch that: simpler, with the context I'm missing

skills.name: paul-skills:wayfinder
skills.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

interface.shortDescription: Map a large effort as decision tickets

skills.name: paul-skills:wireframe
skills.description: Turn agreed task flows and content into low-fidelity interactive screens and a Markdown screen specification. Use when deciding screen hierarchy, controls and responsive order before visual design or production implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Build interactive low-fidelity screen flows
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $wireframe for the scoped product design task and preserve existing decisions.

skills.name: paul-skills:wizard
skills.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.

interface.shortDescription: Generate an interactive setup wizard

skills.name: paul-skills:writing-for-agents
skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

interface.shortDescription: Write documents agents consume
